text:
sara: Quick request — can someone run a focused bench for rumi-5b on g5.48xlarge? Need p50/p95/p99, tail latency (99.9), and token/sec for seq=512, batch=1 and batch=4. Also shard quant/FP16 config v2.

mike: on it. I'll run smoke then full sweep. timeline ~30m for smoke, 2h for full. any golden prompts to include?

sara: thanks. include 10 short chat prompts + 5 long doc-completion prompts (legal-ish text). Also run cold-start vs warmed KV cache.

mike: noted. kicking off smoke now.

bench-bot: started bench job rumi-5b-2291122334 (g5.48x, seq512). smoke: batch1 & batch4, FP16 v2. ETA ~28m. link: https://bench.redwood.internal/jobs/rumi-2291122334

bench-bot: smoke results (prelim) - batch=1: p50=32ms p95=78ms p99=130ms p99.9=240ms tokens/s=480
bench-bot: smoke results - batch=4: p50=45ms p95=110ms p99=195ms p99.9=410ms tokens/s=1650

nina: those p99.9 tails are higher than expected for rumi on this hw. did you see any CPU blocking during warmup?

mike: checking logs. saw a KV cache miss storm on first 50 requests; warmup improves after ~150 requests. attaching snippet: ```
2029-11-06T14:12:45Z INFO kv_cache miss key=conv-92
2029-11-06T14:12:45Z INFO kv_cache miss key=conv-93
...
```

james: curious if the tokenization pattern on the legal prompts creates longer micro-batches causing attention kernel variance. can you paste an example prompt?

sara: here's one (anonymized): "Summarize the following contract clause regarding indemnity and liability limits in plain english, keeping bullets."

oliver: quick thought — try running with continuous-batching disabled for the warmup window. that reduces KV churn in some cases. worth an experiment.

mike: ran a follow-up with warmup-only cache preload + continuous_batching=false for first 200 requests. new p99.9 dropped to 180ms (batch=1) and 310ms (batch=4). full sweep still running.

bench-bot: full sweep finished. publishing consolidated results 
--- FP16 v2, seq512 
batch=1: p50=31ms p95=76ms p99=126ms p99.9=180ms tokens/s=490
batch=4: p50=44ms p95=105ms p99=182ms p99.9=310ms tokens/s=1670
--- cold-start (no preload) p99.9 ~240ms (batch=1)

nina: good improvement with preload. we should codify a micro-preload step during canary start.

sara: agreed. action items: 1) mike to add a preload flag to model-config (PR) 2) nina to add test in rollout playbook 3) oliver to add a note in perf-runbook about disabling continuous batching during warmup.

mike: creating PR now — https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving/pull/8421 (adds preload config + example). pinging reviewers.

nina: I'll review by EOD. also adding a perf regression check to CI that flags >20% p99 delta vs baseline for seq512.

james: can we also log KV cache hit-rate metric to the perf dashboard? that would help correlate spikes.

oliver: I'll add that metric to infra exporter today.

sara: nice. once PR merges, let's schedule a canary with preload enabled and 10% traffic for 2h and monitor p99. If anything >250ms escalate to eng-runtime.

bench-bot: results archived: https://bench.redwood.internal/results/rumi-2291122334. metadata: commit=fea2d8a, hw=g5.48xlarge, config=fp16v2+preload_opt1.

mike: thanks team. will update the PR with links and the smoke vs full sweep numbers. :thumbsup:

nina: cheers. closing loop after canary.

sara: great work — let's aim to include this in next week's release notes under "Model onboarding: rumi-5b" (ops blurb).
